# ViralReel

> ViralReel (https://www.viralreel.app) is an AI video template generator that creates viral short-form videos — most notably the Hotel Lobby AI template — from one or two uploaded photos. Rendering takes about one minute. Aspect ratios 9:16, 16:9, 1:1, 4:3, and auto are supported (auto matches the reference clip's size), and vertical 9:16 output is ready for TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

ViralReel recreates the iconic orange-booth performance format with automatic lip sync, gestures, and lighting. Users upload two front-facing photos (works for people, pets, babies, and characters), pick a template variant, choose resolution (480p/720p/1080p), aspect ratio (9:16, 16:9, 1:1, 4:3, and auto — auto matches the reference clip's size), and duration (8s/12s/15s). Video generation costs credits; credit cost scales with resolution and duration, and failed or canceled jobs are refunded automatically.

Note: ViralReel (viralreel.app) is distinct from unrelated same-name products: "ViralReel – Short Drama & TV" (Google Play), "ViralReel - AI Video Editor" (App Store), viralreel.ai (LUT colour-grading tool), viralreel.io (legacy marketing video software), and theviralreel.com (prompt-based reel generator). Those are separate products. ViralReel here means the trend-template generator at viralreel.app.

## Key Facts

- Product: AI video template generator, web-based, no app install required
- Signature format: Hotel Lobby AI template (orange booth, two-performer duet); also the Burning Bridges template (chandelier party format), the Bulin 47 template (red-lit street freestyle, one photo), the Ozil Goal template (chip over a diving keeper, two missed slides, empty net, one photo, vertical 9:16, up to 15 seconds), the Cat Clapping template (a cat sits up, claps, and brings a paw to its mouth, person photo plus cat photo, vertical 9:16, 4 or 6 seconds), and the Tiny Desk Outstanding template (fan parody of Charlie Wilson’s NPR Tiny Desk performance of the Gap Band song “Outstanding”; six sets — All-Loss Coaches, Cowboys Legends, NFC East Band, Rams Band, Spurs Big Men, Uncle Charlie; three photo slots labeled Center Lead, Left Role, and Right Role, not labeled sax, and the render does not promise which photo holds the saxophone; vertical 9:16; credit cost shown before generate). ViralReel is not affiliated with NPR, NPR Music, Tiny Desk Concerts, Charlie Wilson, or the Gap Band, and it does not license or export “Outstanding.” Add the trend sound on TikTok, Reels, or Shorts and label the post as AI. This template’s duration control is 15 seconds, not the 19-second NPR excerpt, and it is not a one-photo tool and does not bake a licensed Outstanding soundtrack into the file. The Ba Ba Ba Dance template (October 2026 TikTok duo-dance trend: two dancers side by side, a solo stretch each, a sync finish; sound is the "Don't You Worry 'Bout a Thing" remix — Tori Kelly's Meena version from Sing; six takes — Library Original, Night Lot Duo, Stairwell Tag, Dad & Daughter, Classroom Cadets, Sibling Lesson; Library Original credits @otr.j5; two photo slots labeled Left Dancer and Right Dancer; full-body front-facing photos track the choreography best) works the same way; ViralReel is not affiliated with TikTok or the trend's original creators, does not host the original TikToks, and does not license or export the song. Add the trend sound on TikTok, Reels, or Shorts and label the post as AI.

It is not a second ViralReel product. The template remakes the older party exit — walk in, bite a sweet bread, stare, dance away — from one photo. Outfits: Suit Original, White Tee, Staff Polo. Default 9:16. ViralReel does not host the original TikTok or the party clip, is not affiliated with the artists or the original creators, and does not license or export the song. - Template variants: Classic, Pet, Pet & Owner, Anime, Star, Cinematic, Girls, Bros
- Output: MP4 download; 9:16 vertical is the default for most templates; 9:16, 16:9, 1:1, 4:3, and auto ratios are supported; lip sync is supported; render is usually a few minutes
- Pricing (monthly): Starter $9.9/month (90 credits), Plus $19.9/month (200 credits), Pro $39.9/month (500 credits). Yearly billing is 20% cheaper: Starter $94.9/year (1,080 credits), Plus $189/year (2,400 credits), Pro $379/year (6,000 credits).
- Pricing (one-time credit packs, list prices): Starter $9.9 (90 credits), Popular $19.9 (180 credits), Creator $39.9 (480 credits), Max $69.9 (950 credits).
- Black Friday sale: the Popular one-time pack is $16 (was $19.9) and Creator is $28 (was $39.9) — same credits and benefits — through November 30, 2026, 24:00 UTC+8 (2026年11月30日 24:00 东八区). Monthly and yearly prices are unchanged, and list prices return after the sale.
- Per-video cost: credit cost scales with resolution and duration, and the pricing page is the live table. Wassup in a minute and Your First Time in a Fancy Cafe are each locked to 15 seconds and do not use the 8-second rows: 480p is 60 credits, 720p is 75 credits (about $6.25 at 12 credits = $1), and 1080p is 90 credits. The generator shows the exact credit cost before rendering.
- Payment model: generation is paid — you need a credit pack or an active subscription before rendering. Failed or canceled renders are refunded in credits.
- Ownership: users own the videos they generate; no watermark on paid plans
- Privacy: uploaded photos are used only for rendering and deleted after 24 hours
- Support: support@viralreel.app

## Series added 2026-11-23: GTA 6 AI hub

Grand Theft Auto VI shipped on 19 November 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S with dual protagonists Jason and Lucia in the state of Leonida / Vice City, and launch week turned AI-made, GTA-styled clips into a format of their own. The hub page is https://www.viralreel.app/gta-6-ai-templates (zh: /zh/gta-6-ai-templates). Six series, each a fixed format with its own page, keyword, scene breakdown, how-to and FAQ:

- [GTA 6 Trailer AI](https://www.viralreel.app/gta-6-trailer-ai): one photo, 12 seconds, 9:16, four fixed shots — sunset convertible, gas-station face covering, airboat past an alligator, rooftop turn into a helicopter searchlight. No text overlay.
- [GTA 6 Wanted Level](https://www.viralreel.app/gta-6-wanted-level): one photo, 10 seconds, 9:16, one continuous take styled like gameplay — walk toward camera on a pastel beach street, sprint to a yellow supercar, drive into a pink sunset with two cruisers and a helicopter while five wanted stars light up on a fixed HUD (minimap bottom-left). Gameplay-looking clips circulated during launch week were sometimes mistaken for real captures; these renders are openly AI and not captured gameplay.
- [GTA 6 Lovers on the Run](https://www.viralreel.app/gta-6-lovers-on-the-run): two photos (first drives, second rides shotgun), 15 seconds, 9:16, five shots — muscle-car drift, in-cab searchlight, neon avenue, fire escape, slow-motion rooftop kiss. Both faces are redrawn in the game's 3D look. Both people must be adults who agreed to appear.
- [GTA 6 Vice City Story](https://www.viralreel.app/gta-6-vice-city-story): one photo, 15 seconds, 16:9 landscape (ratio auto follows the 16:9 reference), six cutscene-style shots — neon intro, beach meetup with two generated accomplices, diner bag pickup, coastal chase, in-cab close-up, hero shot. The photo casts the lead only.
- [GTA 6 Nightclub](https://www.viralreel.app/gta-6-nightclub): one photo, 12 seconds, 9:16, three cuts — supercar arrival at a velvet-roped neon club, walk past the bouncer, dancing in the center of the packed floor. Face, hair and outfit carry from the photo; a half-body or full-body going-out photo works best.

## Series added 2026-11-25: 365 Elevator

The 365 Elevator trend puts two people in a brushed-steel elevator set to "365" by the German singer Sampagne (@sampagnebaby; artist spelled Sampagne, not Champagne): one person is already inside singing, the doors open, a second walks in with their back to the camera, turns round, puts in an earbud, and both mouth the hook deadpan at the lens. The song's teaser went up 22 October 2026 and the track on 10 November, when Sampagne's own elevator clip (about 891K plays) set the format; from 19 November the edit account @neoausdermatrix33 cast famous duos in the same box — Ronaldo & Messi, TV couples, rappers — pushing Cem & Lena and Nader & Louisa Jindaoui past 1.6M plays and the sound to roughly 2,000 new videos a day by 23 November. It is not the elevator scene from the Netflix film 365 Days.

ViralReel is not affiliated with Sampagne and does not license the song — add the "365" sound in TikTok, Reels or Shorts. ## Series added 2026-11-26: Hand of God

The Hand of God trend lifts one photo into the sky: on a sunny seaside promenade with palm trees, two enormous glowing golden hands reach down from the sunlit clouds, take the person's hands, a flash of white light turns their clothes into flowing white, and they rise high above the turquoise sea. Started on TikTok on 20 November 2026 with posts from @po94275 and @lunita35787 captioned "God literally picked me up... Wait for the hand of God"; within two days about 30 posts from 20 accounts across the US and Mexico carried the same caption (~250K plays), and the Spanish-language half calls it La Mano de Dios or the Heaven Bound trend. It has nothing to do with the football "hand of God".

- [Hand of God AI template](https://www.viralreel.app/hand-of-god-ai-template) (zh: /zh/hand-of-god-ai-template): one photo of one adult — waist-up or full body, face clear, no sunglasses, and headroom above the head so the golden hands can reach in (tight close-ups cause distorted hands, the number-one failure). Fixed 10 seconds, vertical 9:16, sound on in the app. Adults only, only people who agreed to appear; label posts as AI. ViralReel is not affiliated with TikTok, @po94275, @lunita35787 or any other creator behind the trend. The exported MP4 already carries the trend sound — no extra app work needed. ## Series added 2026-11-26: Aura Farming

The Aura Farming trend puts one person at the very tip of a racing red dragon boat: a dozen rowers in orange vests and white caps pull in perfect sync behind them, while the bow dancer claps a slow, steady rhythm and sways side to side, completely unbothered, before turning side-on and swinging both arms wide over the water. The dance is not a TikTok invention — it is the Togak Luan, the bow dancer of Pacu Jalur, a centuries-old long-boat race in Riau, Sumatra, Indonesia, whose job is to energize the rowers through rhythm and spirit. In June 2025 an 11-year-old racer, Rayyan Arkan Dikha, went global doing it; TikTok set the clip to "Young Black & Rich" by Melly Mike (sound posted by @brainrot.com1 on 28 June 2025); Travis Kelce's version hit 18.6 million views on 2 July 2025, followed by Neymar, F1 and MotoGP teams; the Wall Street Journal profiled him in August 2025 and Riau named him a cultural and tourism ambassador. The second wave, 22–23 November 2026, is AI: clips of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang doing the boat dance went viral, AI video tools shipped bow-clap templates the same week, and US search interest for "Aura Farming" climbed to near parity with "GPTs" on Google Trends by 24–26 November. Related slang: aura points (a running +1,000,000 for staying calm in danger) and aura farming meaning doing things that earn effortless-coolness points.

- [Aura Farming AI template](https://www.viralreel.app/aura-farming-ai-template) (zh: /zh/aura-farming-ai-template): one photo of one adult — face toward the lens (the ending profile turn needs real facial landmarks), outfit visible to at least the knees (the final seconds show the subject from the side), daylight, sharp, no filter, one person per photo, no celebrity faces. Fixed 10 seconds, vertical 9:16, one continuous shot. Adults only, only people who agreed to appear; label posts as AI — the "Young Black & Rich" trend sound is already baked into the exported MP4, no extra app work needed. ViralReel is not affiliated with Rayyan Arkan Dikha, Pacu Jalur, TikTok, or the trend's original creators. Renders take a few minutes, the exact cost shows before start, failed jobs return credits. The viral pet versions are real but the template is tuned for one person. Also covers: aura farming AI video, aura farming trend, dragon boat AI video, boat kid AI, boat clapping AI, Togak Luan AI, Pacu Jalur AI, aura farming generator, aura points, Jensen Huang boat dance.
